Reputation decay stops idle sybil farms: an identity starts at 100, loses 8 per epoch after 2 idle epochs, and below 60 loses rewards and voting weight.

Each clone must be worked alone, like a grove where saffron keeps value only if harvested on time; copied work drops it to 20 and freezes it 6 epochs.

Keeping 1,000 clones above 60 costs 3,000 units per epoch; a gale of missed cycles strips 8,000 points, so the farm costs more than it steals.
